visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing glasses and a black-and-white striped shirt, is sitting on a beige sofa in a well-lit indoor room. She is holding several white brochures with a DNA helix graphic and the title "MethClock." Behind her is a white wall with vertical slats and a logo for "DRX Dermatology Clinic." (2) A close-up shot focuses on the brochures, showing the text "MethClock Epigenetics Makes You Healthy." The woman's hands are visible as she holds the papers steady for the camera. (3) The scene returns to the woman on the sofa. She talks enthusiastically, using expressive hand gestures to explain the concept of DNA methylation. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame to summarize her speech. (4) A black-and-white filter is applied to the scene as the woman's facial expression becomes mock-sad or reflective. She continues to hold the reports. (5) The color returns, and she points to specific charts and numbers within the report, highlighting biological age versus chronological age. (6) The video concludes with a static graphic displaying the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone number, and physical addresses in Taipei and New Taipei City.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a energetic female voice speaking in Mandarin, accompanied by a bright, rhythmic electronic pop BGM. The voice is clear and professional, with a high pitch variability. Subtle paper rustling is heard as she handles brochures. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights the mention of "MethClock." The music continues with a steady 4/4 beat. The female speaker's tone is explanatory and high-arousal. (3) A brief comic sound effect plays as the visual filter changes to black and white. The speaker's voice lowers in pitch and volume to mimic sadness. (4) An off-camera male voice briefly interjects with a calm, conversational tone. The background music maintains its upbeat tempo. The female voice resumes with increased volume and excitement, discussing the report's results. (5) Fast-paced cuts in the dialogue are punctuated by subtle UI-style clicks. The music reaches a light peak during the final call to action. The track ends with a short fade-out as the woman finishes speaking.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional educational piece for the 'MethClock' epigenetic age test offered by DRX Dermatology Clinic. The creator explains the scientific concept of DNA methylation and aging, then shares her personal test results, comparing them with her husband's to illustrate how lifestyle and stress affect biological age. The goal is to encourage viewers to book the test at the clinic.
